search_text: published ZDI-17-804 ZDI-CAN-4802 Trend Micro Mobile Security for Enterprise eas_agent_sync_all_devices SlinkId SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2017-09-15 CVE-2017-14078 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2017-14078 10.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:C/I:C/A:C ['Trend Micro'] ['Mobile Security for Enterprise'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Trend Micro Mobile Security for Enterprise. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of the eas_agent_sync_all_devices action. When parsing the 'slink_id' field, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code under the context of SYSTEM. Trend Micro has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
